title: Yellow Roasted Uruguayan Peanut Wrap
description: A roasted, tender, post-workout Uruguayan dish featuring roasted peanut, ssam-wrap, flexitarian-friendly, served in a fondue-pot vessel
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toss the peanuts with 1 tablespoon of olive oil and roast in the oven for 10 minutes.
Toss the yellow squash with 1 tablespoon of olive oil and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
In a large bowl, mix together the roasted peanuts, black beans, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the peanut and bean mixture onto a tortilla and topping with roasted yellow squash.
Serve the wraps in a fondue-pot vessel to keep warm and cozy.
Offer additional toppings such as sliced avocado or sour cream on the side.
